mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate financing costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE increases by >0.5pp in 3 months, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face sector-wide headwinds.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both below 12-month moving averages) fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low monetary policy rate regimes (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals unmitigated supply constraints that erode profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and INDPRO < 95.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 3-month year-over-year CPIAUCSL change does not correlate with negative 5-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A residential construction decline below 500.0 thousand units signals housing market collapse that reduces GDP contribution, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 500.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases above 9.5% and non-farm payrolls declines below 130,000 thousand signal severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 9.5% and PAYEMS < 130000, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 370,000 million dollars), a residential construction decline below 520.0 thousand units signals demand reallocation away from housing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 370000 and HOUST < 520.0, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
